name: GhostEmptyState
description: Presentational empty region with title, description, visual, and actions slots. useGhostEmptyState supplies root and heading bindings.

props.name: as
props.description: Root element. Prefer `div` inside table cells.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: Optional buttons or links; not a tab stop itself.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Optional supporting copy in a div wrapper.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Optional heading copy. Rendered as h1–h6 from headingLevel.

slots.name: visual
slots.description: Optional decorative graphic. Wrapper is aria-hidden.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: Root element after mount; null before mount.

parts.name: title
parts.description: Heading element for the title slot.

keyboard.Tab: Moves through focusable content in the actions slot. The root is not focusable.
